text: AoP also improves Maximum Softmax Probability (MSP) and MaxLogit.

The improvements in out-of-distribution (OOD) detection performance achieved by applying Average of Pruning (AoP) as a plug-in hold across the ResNet variants, WideResNet, VGG, and MobileNet backbones.

Among the three during-training pruning methods evaluated—Gradual Magnitude Pruning (GMP), Rigging the Lottery (RigL), and Gradual Network with neuroregeneration (GraNet)—iterative/post-training LTH performed best for OOD tasks in CIFAR-10 experiments with ResNet-18.
Similar trends hold for WideResNet-28-10 and the other two metrics, area under the precision-recall curve (AUPR) and false positive rate at 95% true positive rate (FPR95).
Similar improvements to those described in 【1, 3】 are observed when AoP is combined with the other confidence estimator Confidence-aware Learning (CRL).
